question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rejected**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3 is: **rejected**.
 
• Explanation: In the context provided, the sentence discusses the methodology of **art training at Kala Bhavan**, an art school founded** by Rabindranath Tagore. **It mentions that studio-based practice was [blank] in favor of learning through observation and living as a part of nature. The word "**rejected**" accurately reflects the idea that studio-based practice was not favored or chosen in this alternative methodology; rather, it was set aside or dismissed.
 
• Meanings of the other options:
 
 
• **accepted** - This word suggests that studio-based practice was embraced or approved, which contradicts the context of the sentence.
 
• **Investigated** - This word implies a process of examination or inquiry, which is not relevant to the context of the sentence.
 
• **aspired** - This word means to have a strong desire or ambition, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**rejected**," as it best reflects the idea that studio-based practice was not chosen in favor of the alternative methodology described.

 

Correct Passage:__ *Rabindranath Tagore founded a small school at Santiniketan in 1901 and Kala Bhavan, an art school, in 1919 which later became a part of the Visvabharati University founded in 1921. Located in an idyllic village some distance from the city of Calcutta, Kala Bhavan presented an alternative methodology of art training, in which studio based practice was **rejected** in favour of learning through observation and living as a part of nature. The natural surroundings with the (4)________ of bare red earth dotted with trees, the colours of the changing seasons, the animals and birds (5)________ inspiration to students.*
